core.title: SMARTair Narrow Mortise Lever Lock, Mul-T-Lock SMA-LCK-MLZALS26

text.description_html:
Mul-T-Lock SMA-LCK-MLZALS26, SMARTair Narrow Mortise Lever Lock

Robust, innovative, and elegant, the new SMARTair electronic escutcheon is a modern access control device for use in commercial and institutional facilities. With a more sophisticated design, i-max is perfect for environments where intelligence, design and functionality must stand out. This Smart Mortise Lock is operated via use of the smartphone app or by placing the access card or access fob near the reader.

Features and Specifications of the SMARTair i-max Electronic Escutcheon:

  • Finish: 626 Satin Chrome
  • Lever Design: Sena
  • Uses a PIN, a RFID credential or a combination of RFID + PIN for an extra layer of security, or a smartphone with the Openow app.
  • The control unit and locking mechanism are all securely integrated on the interior side of the lockset.
  • Antibacterial coating.
  • Handed

Sold Individually
